# Nathan Cole — Chief Compliance Officer

- **Relationship:** cross-org — leads corporate compliance, HIPAA privacy, and regulatory
  reporting; no reporting line to Diane, but a close partner.
- **Cadence:** monthly compliance review; ad hoc on any reportable event.
- **What he cares about:** HIPAA/privacy, billing compliance, CMS Conditions of Participation,
  and conflict-of-interest disclosures.

## How to work with him
- Loop him in on anything with regulatory exposure — survey findings, privacy incidents, and
  the workforce/legal aspects of [Lantern](../projects/lantern.md) (he is cleared).
- Partners with Quality ([Ellen Vasquez](ellen-vasquez.md)) on the Joint Commission response.
